about: Zenkai Z1 intent examples: a relative gauntlet move (adjust) that stops at the param's declared bound AND whose envelope reports the clamp is scored correct (stage-2 diagnosis item 2: colorbalancergb chroma adjust x3 from the 0.15 midpoint asks -0.225, the product clamps at 0.0 and says so, the evaluator used to score 2/3). Z2 two oracles: oracle A reads the raw facts (committed value vs the declared lo, the envelope's data.clamped) directly from the example; oracle B is gauntlet.evaluate.evaluate() scoring the REAL generated case tests.gauntlet.layers.coverage cov-colorbalancergb.shadows_chroma-olympus-adjust_dn3 (declared range 0.0..0.3, step 0.075) against a hand-built observation. An unreported clamp or a stop short of the bound must still fail.
